book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Tambiy wei vanei lepa yo
Moxo di loum axone veil lukendu, eno xel qendu ngandoung ti betiwou e.
De tambiy ti is vanei lepa eno lam ev vaxakatu eivek wou e me neil, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wangwei wa laleim devind nei, yon wang bong am bo nimzalek.”
Yesu tatei mema la me axlek e, de neil, “A laleing vind! Wang bo vako.” Lutika eno moxo xe vanei lepa yon ma veil e.
Woyom Yesu neil wou e, “Wang wei inyon dom wa se neil wou xelti. Qe la, me talex xow wou lumuki me toung xound teyei lek Mose neil o, en xel boulek pavulek ne bei wa xe myavanei yon ma.”
Lei ngandoung wei vevek o xe wongeingis
Ka Yesu la eivek beyeeng Kapenaom, beyeiv wei mi yeiteyei 100 vevekyeiw eno ti lam wou e me teling wou en vineing.
Moxo neil, “Tambiy Ngandoung, a xe xukxe eno vanei wong om di yeip lek zek eivek xomek lalei. Moxo kanzek mey me di axe vanei ngandoung.”
Yesu neil wou e, “Tyek a nak me na bong embo nimzalek.”
Ekom beyeiv neil elox bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, a se nimza bei wang nam eivek a bang lalei. Qe wa mou neil qayeeng dom a xe xukxe e bo nimzalek.

En a maxow ne a mindei kwanghembi eivek xel wei wo leind ngandoung o, me xel vevek mindei kwanghembi eivek ay. Wangwei a neil wou tine, ‘La,’ ond moxo la. De na neil wou nge yon, ‘Lam,’ ond moxo lam. Me a neil wou a xe xukxe, ‘Wong tine,’ ond moxo mi wong.”
Yesu ngo qayeeng tine, moxo etek mouyo me neil wou eti yeiw wei di betiwou e yon, “A neil wou xam zonghek, a se mi xei tambiy ti eivek Israel eno xe wongeingis ambei nye.
A neil wou xam bei inyon xel ngenong tyek nam anghei ninei me xeinei, me nam mendei me gya mata ngandoung on is Apraham aluw Isaka lal Yakop eivek tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu nei.
Ekom xomaxoneing wei Israel wei tete lalei eno tyek Anutu banex xel na myayaing eivek mapetok ngandoung, nanghei inyon eno tyek xel bong talot ngandoung me dexound newound bo nyiknyik.”
Woyom Yesu neil wou beyeiv, “La! En tyek na tyip ambei ingwei wang wongis bei etyip o.” De e xe xukxe wo nimzalek seivma kayon.
Yesu wong xel ngenong wo nimzalek
Woyom Yesu lam eivek Petele xe xomek, moxo yei Petele yeing avexta gying wong me e di yeip lek zek.
Moxo axlek e mema de gying on ma veil e, me vexo qandi lek me di menyex lulul wou e.
Soukeing tiyon, eno xel ngenong wei memo dei eivek xel eno liyeiw qou xel me lam wou Yesu. Me e neil de xel laweeng nilul on la myayaing me wong xel ngenong wei vanei eno wo nimzalek.
De kwa tine la teyei lek vati wei Anutu neil eivek poropet Yesaya mya yo:

content.text: “E maxow qou xe xe myavanei leimalei
me semaleeng xe xe vanei leimalei veil.” Yesaya 53:4

content: Yesu neil en nimaying wei betiyeing wou e yo
Gyeik Yesu yei xel qendu ngandoung wei nale vivekwou e yon, moxo neil nikanzek wou xel betiyeing bei, “Xey a na nge loxalu wei lounyeing nei.”
Woyom putoung wei petieing o ti eno lam wou e me neil, “Putoung, wambei mi na inya yo eno tyek a betiwou wang.”
Yesu neil elox bei, “Xel naw bemeeng xe eeng me menek menek xe lewis, ekom Xomaxoneing Neu Moux xe beyeeng wei embei ni lu lek eno ma.”
Betiyeing nge neil wou e, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wong a la ev mang wole.”
Ekom Yesu neil wou e, “Wa betiwou ay, dom wong xel meyeing di ev xel venaxow xe meyeing.”
Yesu neil dom laweeng valeivek on tip
Woyom moxo la eivek bot de e xe xel betiyeing betiwou e.
Se wo lululek, qe laweeng ngandoung ti tyip wou xel lek lounyeing masenghoing, omek laweeng vei lounyeing lam embei sevunexe bot is xel. Ekom Yesu vena di yeip.
Xel betiyeing la me piyexe e, me neil, “Tambiy Ngandoung, vind xa! Xey am bim a qou nilul ne!”
Moxo neil elox, “Xam xe wongeingis on nayaka, nambei nya xam ghe waleeng?” Woyom moxo qandi lek me luk nikanzek wou laweeng me mamileeng wei di vuk me lam on yeip kanzek, me wo nimza no.
Xel moux on etek me teling, “Tambiy tine e vati? Om memiing aluw laweeng ngo e vya!”
Yesu tiy memo veil tambiy yayuw

Ka Yesu la tei lounyeing nge loxalu wei Gadarayeiw xe tembuing nei, eno moux yayuw wei memo dei eivek luw eno lam myayaing veil eeng wei xel qateiv eivek qakous o me lam wou e. Tambiy yuw on bemeeng om xelti se teyei bei na nox sakwaing tiyon.
Woyom luw ghak, “Anutu Neu Moux, wa being bo vati wou uw? Beip wang lam inye bei bo nol wou uw de bouk anghei?”
Bok qendu ngandoung ti di ya ghei dingta ka nanghei inyon en xel.
Laweeng nol yon tay wou Yesu, “Wangwei wa tiy xa na myayaing nei, on wong xa la eivek bok qendu ngandoung nei.”
Moxo neil wou xel, “Xam la!” Om xel lam myayaing me la eivek xel bok on, me bok qendu tiyon dalus veimyend me la oing mazanghei me heivek lounyeing de mey eivek memiing.
Xel wei mi yeiteyei bok on yei tine, om xel veimyend me la eivek beyeeng on me neil qayeeng dalus en tine, me vati wei belup wou moux yuw wei memo mindei eivek luw o.
Woyom xel tambak wei beyeeng on la wou Yesu. Me gyeik xel yei e, xel luk nikanzek wou e bei ena veil xel xe tembuing.
